claims.summary: The release is driven by a live EduTool.dev Microeconomics package where the run digest recorded native-authoring prose fallback but the package report only showed the assessment-coverage observation.
The deep package grader converts digest pipeline.nativeAuthoring prose fallbacks into P2 honesty findings with digest evidence.
When PACKAGE_MANIFEST.json omits a native-authoring fallback that is present in the digest, the quality report names that missing disclosure explicitly.
Regression coverage builds a package with a digest-only native fallback, checks QUALITY_REPORT.md, and regrades the ZIP path to prove the fallback caveat survives export.
The release boundary keeps CourseIR one-call compiler work behind its existing live side-by-side proof gates while this patch improves the current report-truth layer.
